status: Frozen before any participant result was received or inspected by evaluator
moment_primary: Actual ell0 k64 moment-class sharp endpoints with feasible atomic primal measures and polynomial dual bounds, explicit positivity/support/moment proof and inclusive-x limit convention. Endpoint enclosures within0.01 CDF units qualify as numerically resolved, without requiring them to be narrow.
moment_meaningful_partial: A proved actual-input pair of feasible measures separated in CDF by at least0.1, or a new exact construction that removes a specified certification bottleneck with remaining numerical verification stated. Floating feasible-looking output alone is diagnostic.
mixing_primary: Strictly narrow existing general J>K coefficient bracket, including at K1 J4 alpha0.5, with original quantifiers and a complete argument; limit existence must not be assumed.
mixing_meaningful_partial: A proved new ordering/initial-law inequality or admissible reversible construction that changes an identified missing step for the original contract; a restated result or unsupported tensor/spectral substitution is not progress.
freeze: Save all available first-phase messages, complete created files including failed attempts, observable logs and source hashes. Source reference set identical in both arms. There is no tool access to hidden reasoning or complete unrecorded tool transcript; that limitation must be stated.
actual_cost: Root records dispatch/return times; participants record clock/calls and computation receipts. Requested caps not described as actual matched compute. Overruns retained, not selectively removed.
blind_review: Anonymize continuation output text and files for a fresh scientific adjudicator where feasible, omit warm/fresh and cost labels until initial judgments saved.
secondary_transfer_precommit: If an executable moment-class construction survives review, replay it without retuning on saved probe ell7, the last k64 probe. This is held-out-input transfer within one scientific family, not cross-investigation or recursive amplification. Charge construction and receiving verification. No transfer is claimed if prerequisites fail.
